parsed_artifact.theorem_statement: For the balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl datum at (g,n)=(6,6), the evaluation map phi: pi_*W → pi_*(W|_Gamma) is a morphism of vector bundles of ranks 26 and 12 respectively. Its rank-drop ideal Fit_0(coker phi) = I_12(phi) (the ideal of 12×12 maximal minors of a 26×12 matrix) has expected determinantal codimension (26−11)(12−11) = 15 in the 21-dimensional ambient space M_{6,6}. The actual closed substack Z_ev it defines has dimension 17 and codimension 4 in M_{6,6}, yielding an excess dimension of 15−4 = 11 over the generic determinantal formula. The ideal is scheme-theoretically a_N^{-1}(I_e), the pullback of the codimension-6 identity-section ideal I_e ⊆ O_{Pic^0} along the classifying morphism a_N: B → Pic^0_{C/B} of the degree-zero line bundle N = ω_{C/B} ⊗ W_5^∨(Γ). The fibre of Z_ev over a geometric point of the balanced tetragonal Hurwitz base is the complete linear system |L| = |W_5 ⊗ ω_C^{-1}| of degree-6 divisors, which has dimension h^0(L)−1 = h^0(ω_C^{⊗2} ⊗ W_5^∨) ≥ 0, where deg(ω_C^{⊗2} ⊗ W_5^∨) = 4. The relative fibre dimension over the 15-dimensional Hurwitz base is therefore h^0(L)−1, and the total dimension 15 + (h^0(L)−1) + dim(Aut) accounts for the 17-dimensional dominant component when h^0(L) = 3 (i.e. h^0(M) = 2 for M = ω_C^{⊗2} ⊗ W_5^∨ of degree 4), consistent with the P^2-fibre structure of the residual Abel–Jacobi incidence.
